== Notes ==
* Works well with [[scythe]]s or [[Attack#Skills dealing multiple attacks|attack skills that can deal multiple attacks]].
* [[Hero]]es will only cast Brutal Weapon on party members who are engaged in combat and are wielding a martial weapon. Heroes will not take the enchantment conditional into consideration, and will not cast Brutal Weapon on an ally outside of their party.
* Excellent for [[Ranger]]s, [[Warrior]]s, and [[Paragon]]s, as they have no enchantments of their own to prevent Brutal Weapon's bonus.
* [[Dervish]]es are able to work around Brutal Weapon's enchantment restriction, since all [[teardown]]s trigger ''before'' the scythe attack hits, thereby granting Brutal Weapon's bonus.
